restriction_review.scope: Thirty independently qualified Effusion or Elixir bodies from twelve named families, selected tiers I-X. All selected direct primary output IDs, literal formulas, quantities, numeric trivials, explicit charge1/stack20 profiles and Shaman requirement were observed. Shared ingredients authenticate by explicit primary EQ item IDs; no body is inferred by replacing a herb or copying a tier.
restriction_review.historical: SOE developer Ngreth dated2006-03-13 exchange list explicitly names these Effusion and Elixir families and old-potion mappings at V/VII/VIII/X among the identities. Contemporaneous2006 family list last edited2011 lists all twelve named effects and discusses cap effects on VII-X in a dated2006 reply. Positive pre-RoF identity/family evidence supports labelled PoR11 family reconstruction for I-X. Per-item maintained primary formulas and numeric trivials independently govern manufacturing. No immutable2006/May2013 full-field claim or exact introduction date; no XI+ inference.
restriction_review.actor: Every source explicitly requires Shaman. Existing normal and auto Alchemy code checks Shaman and minimum level25. Skill59; omitted minimum skill0, ordinary must_learn0/book0/quest0/enabled1/nofail0 policies. Static actor mapping reused from RRC221, no core edits or native acceptance.
restriction_review.quantity: Every source yields one physical stackable potion with explicit Charges1 and source stackcap20. Every current native output has maxcharges1/stackable1/stacksize20. successcount1 therefore creates one one-charge physical potion; this uses explicit source count, not a maximum-charge default. Literal repeated herbs4 or3, distinct tier-specific inputs and individual numeric trivials retained. Six or seven physical input units fit bag. No invented empty-vial returns, co-products or normalization of native item fields.
restriction_review.containers: Bind only exact portable Medicine Bag17901, independently authenticated primary1141, eight slots and LARGE capacity. All ingredient sizes and at most seven physical units fit current native bag fields. Other named bags and modern Alchemy Tables remain separately unqualified.
restriction_review.preservation: 69 exact18-field dependencies: 59 fresh and 10 reused. Zero current all-state/all-skill full-input/name matches or positive-success output peers. New IDs/full logical entry multisets/counts/learned references guarded. Existing items, recipes, quests, core and player data unchanged.
restriction_review.execution: Source prepared for normal publication and exact one-use SQL GO. Named count contracts; no new rehearsal, tests, build, restart or native gameplay campaign. Overall recipe coverage remains incomplete.
